content.rendered:
The team at our convenient Mystic Auto Drive-Up Branch is eager to help you with your banking transactions and to refer you to other locations for your more complex banking needs. 

Address:
50 Stonington Road
Mystic, CT 06355
Get Directions

Phone: 860-572-4082
Fax: 860-572-4087 

Send an email

Mystic Auto Bank Express is drive-up only.

Drive-up Hours
Mon – Fri 8:00am – 4:00pm (Branch closes from 11:00am – 11:30am) • Sat 9:00am – 12:00pm

Video Banking ATM
Mon – Fri 8:00am – 7:00pm • Sat 9:00am – 3:00pm

Personal Banking Services

  • Cash and check deposits and withdrawals
  • Bank checks and money orders
  • Coin orders
  • Accept loan payments
  • Accept safe deposit box payments
  • Night depository for businesses
  • ATM
  • Online and mobile banking
  • Free Learning Hub

Business Banking

  • Night depository
